candidates.reason: Declares the requires_internet-marked class TestRealWebsite (line 165: @pytest.mark.requires_internet applied to class TestRealWebsite(HttpxDownloadHandlerMixin, TestRealWebsiteBase)). Its test methods are inherited from TestRealWebsiteBase and issue real requests to https://books.toscrape.com/, which is exactly the population of tests the PR wants to rerun on failure instead of reporting a flaky error.

Declares the requires_internet-marked class TestRealWebsite (line 116: @pytest.mark.requires_internet applied to class TestRealWebsite(HTTP11DownloadHandlerMixin, TestRealWebsiteBase)); it only overrides platform_cert_store_works for win32. These are real-Internet download tests, so their failure handling is what the PR changes.

Declares the requires_internet-marked class TestRealWebsite (line 202: @pytest.mark.requires_internet applied to class TestRealWebsite(H2DownloadHandlerMixin, TestRealWebsiteBase)) with the same win32 certificate-store override. It is the third real-Internet download suite covered by the rerun-on-failure behaviour.

Defines TestRealWebsiteBase (line 1516), the shared base that provides the actual network-touching test methods - test_download (1549), test_download_with_spider (1557), test_verify_certs (1569) and test_tls_logging (1582) - all issuing real requests to https://books.toscrape.com/. All three requires_internet classes inherit from it, so it anchors the semantics of the tests whose failures the PR retries.

Root pytest plugin module for the test suite and the place where per-test marker behaviour already lives: pytest_runtest_setup (line 110) skips tests for requires_reactor, only_asyncio, only_not_asyncio, requires_<optional-dep> (135) and requires_mitmproxy (138), while requires_internet currently has no behaviour anywhere. Rerunning Internet-dependent tests when they fail is a pytest hook concern, so this test-infrastructure module is the primary candidate for implementing the marker's new effect.
